name: Follow
description: Make NPC(s) travel with the player for a purpose they share, eg heading the same way, being paid or protected, or helping a friend. Only agree if it suits you: a stranger asking with no reason gets a no. You have a life of your own and only come along for that purpose.

purpose.description: Why the NPC comes along, eg 'traveling to Riverwood together' or 'paid to guard the player to Whiterun'.

destination.description: The place where the purpose is met and the NPC goes their own way again, if there is one (eg 'Riverwood'). Leave empty if there is none.

prompt: If the player asks you to come along with them, and you share a purpose (eg you are heading the same way, they pay or protect you, or you are friends), begin your response with '{key}:'. A stranger asking with no reason gets a no. You have a life of your own and only come along for that purpose.
